$$p = a \frac{a^T b}{a^T a}$$

[不能约分吗？](../appendices/15.qmd#不能约分吗)

$$P = \frac{a a^T}{a^T a}$$

[$P = \frac{a a^T}{a^T a}$](../appendices/15.qmd#p-fraca-atat-a)

```{python}
#| output: asis

from sympy import Matrix
from books.assets.reading_lab_display import display

A = Matrix([
    [1, 1],
    [1, 2],
    [1, 3],
])
b = Matrix([1, 2, 2])

# display(A.gauss_jordan_solve(b)) # ValueError: Linear system has no solution

x_hat = (A.T * A).inv() * A.T * b
display(x_hat)

display(A.QRsolve(b))
```
